title: measurement
description: Measured quantity represented as a time series for one location, measurement period and quantity type.

unit.description: Unit of the measured quantity. kWh represents hydrogen energy and molPercent represents hydrogen content.

x-enumDescriptions.HydrogenContent: Hydrogen content of the measured gas.

values.description: Chronologically ordered time-series values. Each value represents the measured quantity for one interval. The interval duration is defined by measurementData.granularity.

status.description: Origin or processing status of the measurement value.

x-enumDescriptions.measured: The value originates from an actual measurement.
x-enumDescriptions.estimated: The value was estimated or calculated because no directly usable measurement was available.
x-enumDescriptions.replaced: The original value was unavailable, invalid or unusable and was replaced by the quantity declaration.
x-enumDescriptions.missing: No valid value is available for the relevant interval.
